name: Caleb Martin Adams
notable_stories: He was killed in a car accident in Kansas City.
milestones: Birth: 13 January 1875, Mendon, Chariton County, MO
Death: 15 November 1951, Kansas City, Jackson County, MO
Married Louise A. Gosnell (Adams) (m. 4 Oct 1899, St. Louis, Jackson County, MO)
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Son of Col. Alexander William Adams and Mary Louisa Martin. Source: Adams Family Doc.
